blocks.md: This lesson follows **Historical Perspective and Further Reading** in *Supervisory Intervention* (Vol IV).

blocks.source: Vol IV, Supervisory Intervention, § Historical Perspective and Further Reading
blocks.md: Supervisory control emerged as an engineering discipline when teleoperated systems outgrew direct manual control. In deep-sea exploration and hazardous environment manipulation, transmission latency and high operator workloads made continuous teleoperation fragile. @sheridan1978human formalized the division of labor between human operators and machine intelligence, grading autonomy into explicit levels that range from complete manual execution to autonomous computer execution that ignores human input. @sheridan1992telerobotics consolidated these insights into a unified systems theory of human supervisory control, modeling how human operators alternate between planning, programming, monitoring, intervening, and learning from automated subroutines.

blocks.prompt: Think first: In two or three sentences, explain why Authority record matters for the system this section describes.
blocks.md: Compare your answer with the book's claim: The authority record binds a sealed static authority manifest to a per-tick evidence tuple of time, authority state, measured state, proposed and admitted commands, so every handover is reconstructable and attributable.

questions.q: The section **Historical Perspective and Further Reading** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Automation leaves the human the hardest, least-time cases with degraded skill and a stale forward model, so oversight degrades exactly when it is needed.

Autonomous chunks and manual sessions hold separate leases on the safety MCU's clock, so a silent policy, a dropped link, or an incapacitated operator loses authority to a state-matched local fallback.

A setpoint swap at commit demands an unbounded command derivative, so the enforcer blends between latched endpoints with a quintic smoothstep whose duration is set by the rate limit and paid from stopping reserve.

The authority record binds a sealed static authority manifest to a per-tick evidence tuple of time, authority state, measured state, proposed and admitted commands, so every handover is reconstructable and attributable.
